name: What is the difference between pre-hung and slab doors?
description: Pre-hung doors include the frame for easier installation, while slab doors are just the door panel, used with existing frames.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between pre-hung and slab doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pre-hung doors come with a frame already attached, making them easier and quicker to install, especially in new construction or when replacing an entire door unit. Slab doors are just the door panel itself, without a frame or hardware. Slab doors are typically used when you want to keep your existing frame or are replacing a door within an existing opening that is still in good condition.
